name: fp_admin_remote_exec
label: false_positive
description: A systems administrator running remote execution against servers during a maintenance window, from a management workstation, with a named admin account.
detectable_as: Indistinguishable from lateral movement on process and logon evidence alone. Separating it needs the account's role, the source host, and whether a change window was open.
why_hard: A detection keyed on remote execution tooling alone fires on this every maintenance window, and gets muted.
